name: Push-Up
instructions: Start in a high plank position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body until your chest nearly touches the floor, keeping your elbows at a 45-degree angle.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Keep your core tight and body in a straight line throughout the movement.

name: Incline Push-Up
instructions: Place your hands on an elevated surface such as a bench or sturdy chair.
Walk your feet back so your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the edge of the surface by bending your elbows.
Press through your hands to return to the starting position.

name: Decline Push-Up
instructions: Place your feet on an elevated surface such as a bench or sturdy chair.
Position your hands on the floor slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows while keeping your body straight.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Press the dumbbells up to full arm extension above your chest, palms facing forward.
Lower the dumbbells in a controlled manner until they are level with your chest.
Press the dumbbells back up to the starting position.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set a bench to a 30-45 degree incline and sit with a dumbbell in each hand on your thighs.
Press the dumbbells up to full arm extension above your upper chest.
Lower the dumbbells slowly until they are level with your chest, with elbows out to the sides.
Press the dumbbells back up to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Lie flat on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms extended above your chest, palms facing each other.
With a slight bend in your elbows, lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc.
Lower until you feel a stretch across your chest, keeping your elbows slightly bent throughout.
Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbells back together above your chest.

name: Cable Chest Fly
instructions: Stand between two cable pulleys set at shoulder height, grasping a handle in each hand.
Step forward slightly to create tension on the cables, with arms extended out to the sides.
With a slight bend in your elbows, bring the handles together in front of your chest in a hugging motion.
Slowly return to the starting position, controlling the resistance as your arms open back out.

name: Chest Dip
instructions: Grip parallel bars and lift yourself to a straight-arm position, leaning your torso slightly forward.
Bend your elbows to lower your body until your upper arms are parallel to the floor or below.
Keep your elbows flared out and your torso leaned forward to emphasize chest engagement.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.

name: Diamond Push-Up
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands close together under your chest, forming a diamond shape with your index fingers and thumbs.
Lower your chest toward your hands by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
Pause briefly at the bottom when your chest is just above your hands.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.

name: Wide Grip Push-Up
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands placed significantly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows out to the sides.
Lower until your chest is a few inches from the floor while keeping your body in a straight line.
Press through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Lie with your upper back across a flat bench, feet flat on the floor for stability.
Hold a single dumbbell with both hands directly above your chest, arms slightly bent.
Lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head until you feel a stretch in your chest and lats.
Pull the dumbbell back to the starting position by contracting your chest muscles.

name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your eyes under the bar and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unrack the bar and hold it directly above your chest with arms fully extended.
Lower the bar to your mid-chest in a controlled manner, keeping your elbows at roughly 45 degrees.
Press the bar back up to the starting position by driving through your feet and pushing with your chest.

name: Incline Barbell Press
instructions: Set a bench to a 30-45 degree incline and lie back with your eyes under the bar.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width and unrack it above your upper chest.
Lower the bar to your upper chest in a controlled manner.
Press the bar back up to full arm extension, focusing on engaging your upper chest.

name: Svend Press
instructions: Stand upright holding a light dumbbell or weight plate between your palms at chest level.
Press your palms together firmly to create isometric tension across your chest.
Extend your arms straight out in front of your chest, squeezing your pecs throughout.
Pull the weight back to your chest in a controlled motion and repeat.

name: Medicine Ball Chest Pass
instructions: Stand facing a wall or a partner, holding a medicine ball at chest level with both hands.
Hold the ball close to your chest with elbows tucked to your sides.
Explosively push the ball forward by extending your arms and pushing through your chest.
Catch the ball as it returns and bring it back to your chest before the next repetition.

name: Isometric Chest Squeeze
instructions: Stand or sit upright and press your palms together in front of your chest at a 90-degree angle.
Squeeze your palms together as hard as you can, activating your chest muscles.
Hold the contraction for the desired duration while breathing steadily.
Relax briefly and then repeat the squeeze.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing forward.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders by bending your elbows.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down.
Avoid swinging your body or using momentum throughout the exercise.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing your body.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders while keeping your palms facing each other.
Squeeze at the top, then lower the dumbbells back to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides throughout the movement.

name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with your legs spread apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Rest the back of your upper arm against the inside of your same-side thigh.
Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder by bending your elbow, squeezing your bicep at the top.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position and complete all reps before switching arms.

name: Tricep Dips
instructions: Grip parallel bars and lift yourself up with arms straight, shoulders down away from your ears.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your elbows tracking straight back throughout the movement.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Stand or sit holding a single dumbbell with both hands behind your head, arms bent.
Keep your upper arms close to your ears and extend your elbows to press the dumbbell overhead.
Straighten your arms fully at the top without locking your elbows.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back behind your head by bending your elbows.

name: Tricep Kickback
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Keep your upper arm parallel to your torso and your elbow bent at 90 degrees.
Extend your forearm back until your arm is fully straight, squeezing your tricep at the top.
Slowly return to the starting position by bending your elbow back to 90 degrees.

name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing inward.
With a slight bend in your elbows, raise the dumbbells out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to your sides.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders or using momentum to lift the weights.

name: Front Raise
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides or in front of your thighs, palms facing your body.
With a slight bend in your elbows, raise one or both dumbbells straight out in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower the dumbbells back down in a controlled manner.
Keep your torso stationary and avoid rocking to generate momentum.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Attach a resistance band to a door anchor or fixed point at face height.
Grip the ends of the band with both hands and step back to create tension.
Pull the band toward your face, driving your elbows back and rotating your hands outward.
Squeeze your rear deltoids and upper back at the end position, then slowly return to the start.

name: Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest your forearms on your thighs with your palms facing up, wrists hanging over your knees.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and let your wrists extend so the dumbbells lower toward the floor.
Curl your wrists up by contracting your forearm muscles to lift the dumbbells.
Squeeze at the top and then lower back down slowly.

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest your forearms on your thighs with your palms facing down, wrists hanging over your knees.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and let your wrists extend so the dumbbells lower toward the floor.
Curl your wrists upward by contracting your forearm extensors to lift the dumbbells.
Squeeze at the top and then lower back down slowly.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip at shoulder width, arms fully extended.
Curl the barbell up toward your shoulders by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms still.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the barbell back down.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and avoid swinging your body.

name: Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie flat on a bench holding a barbell with a narrow grip directly above your chest.
Keeping your upper arms perpendicular to the floor, bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Stop just before the bar touches your forehead or the top of your head.
Extend your elbows to press the bar back to the starting position.

name: Push Down
instructions: Stand facing a cable machine with a straight bar or rope attachment set at the high pulley position.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip, elbows bent at your sides.
Push the bar down by extending your elbows until your arms are fully straight.
Slowly return the bar to the starting position by letting your elbows bend back to 90 degrees.

name: Arnold Press
instructions: Sit on a bench holding dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing your body, elbows bent.
As you press the dumbbells overhead, rotate your palms outward so they face forward at the top.
Lower the dumbbells back down while rotating your palms to face your body again.
Keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

name: Shrugs
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with arms fully extended.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears as high as possible.
Hold the top position for a moment, squeezing your traps.
Slowly lower your shoulders back to the starting position.

name: Plank
instructions: Start in a forearm plank position with your elbows directly under your shoulders and forearms on the floor.
Extend your legs behind you with your toes on the floor, lifting your body off the ground.
Keep your body in a straight line from your head to your heels, engaging your core.
Hold the position without letting your hips sag or rise for the target duration.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side with your forearm on the floor, elbow directly under your shoulder.
Stack your feet on top of each other and lift your hips off the floor.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to feet, engaging your obliques.
Hold the position without letting your hips drop for the target duration, then switch sides.

name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head and your legs raised with knees bent at 90 degrees.
Bring your right elbow toward your left knee while extending your right leg straight out.
Switch sides by bringing your left elbow toward your right knee while extending your left leg.
Continue alternating in a pedaling motion, rotating through your core with each repetition.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms extended straight up toward the ceiling and knees bent at 90 degrees above your hips.
Press your lower back firmly into the floor to engage your core.
Simultaneously lower your right arm behind your head and extend your left leg straight out toward the floor.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side, keeping your lower back pressed down.

name: Bird Dog
instructions: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Extend your right arm forward and your left leg back simultaneously until both are parallel to the floor.
Hold the extended position briefly, keeping your hips level and core braced.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.

name: Mountain Climber
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands under your shoulders and body in a straight line.
Drive your right knee toward your chest as quickly as possible.
Immediately switch legs, driving your left knee toward your chest while extending your right leg back.
Continue alternating legs in a running motion, keeping your hips low and core engaged.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet lifted slightly off the ground.
Lean back slightly to engage your core, keeping your spine straight.
Clasp your hands together or hold a weight at your chest and rotate your torso to the right.
Rotate to the left side in a controlled motion, completing one repetition per side.

name: Leg Raise
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your lower back or at your sides for support.
Keeping your legs straight, raise them toward the ceiling until they are perpendicular to the floor.
Lower your legs slowly back toward the floor without letting them touch down.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor throughout the movement.

name: Reverse Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, arms at your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor and lift your feet off the ground, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Curl your hips off the floor by contracting your lower abs, rolling your pelvis toward your ribs.
Slowly lower your hips and legs back to the starting position in a controlled manner.

name: Toe Touch Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended straight up toward the ceiling, feet flexed.
Extend your arms toward your toes with your shoulders lifted off the floor.
Reach your fingertips toward your toes by contracting your upper abs.
Lower your shoulders back to the floor and repeat, keeping your legs stationary.

name: Hollow Body Hold
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Press your lower back firmly into the floor and lift your shoulders and legs off the ground.
Reach your arms and legs in opposite directions, creating a shallow banana or boat shape.
Hold the position while breathing steadily, keeping your lower back pressed into the floor.

name: Ab Rollout
instructions: Kneel on a mat and grip the ab roller handles with both hands, arms bent at 90 degrees.
Roll the ab roller forward by extending your arms, allowing your hips to follow.
Continue rolling out until your body is nearly parallel to the floor, keeping your core tight.
Pull the ab roller back toward your knees by engaging your abs to return to the starting position.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel facing a cable machine with a rope attachment set at the high pulley position.
Hold the rope behind your head with both hands, elbows pointed down.
Crunch your torso downward by contracting your abs, bringing your elbows toward your knees.
Slowly return to the upright starting position in a controlled manner.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms fully extended and shoulders engaged.
Keeping your legs straight, raise them up toward the bar by contracting your lower abs.
Lift until your legs are at least parallel to the floor or higher if possible.
Lower your legs back down in a controlled motion without swinging.

name: Flutter Kick
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands under your lower back or at your sides for support.
Lift both legs a few inches off the floor with your legs straight.
Alternate kicking your legs up and down in small, rapid scissor-like motions.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor and your core engaged throughout.

name: V-Up
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Simultaneously lift your torso and legs off the floor, reaching your hands toward your toes.
Fold your body into a V-shape at the top, balancing on your sit bones.
Lower your arms and legs back to the starting position in a controlled manner.

name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended in front of you or at your sides.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower your body as if sitting into a chair.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, keeping your chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand back up to the starting position.

name: Lunges
instructions: Stand with your feet together and your hands on your hips or at your sides.
Step forward with one leg and lower your hips until both knees are bent at approximately 90 degrees.
Keep your front knee directly over your ankle and your back knee hovering just above the floor.
Push through your front heel to step back to the starting position and repeat on the other side.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides.
Press through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling until your body forms a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and hold for a moment.
Lower your hips back down to the floor in a controlled manner.

name: Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on the edge of a step or flat on the floor with your feet hip-width apart.
Rise up onto your toes as high as possible by extending your ankles.
Hold the top position briefly, squeezing your calf muscles.
Lower your heels back down slowly below the level of the step if using one, or to the floor.

name: Wall Sit
instructions: Stand with your back flat against a wall and your feet shoulder-width apart.
Slide your back down the wall until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Keep your knees directly above your ankles and your back pressed against the wall.
Hold the position for the target duration without letting your hips rise.

name: Dumbbell Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides or at your shoulders.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat position.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, keeping your chest up.
Drive through your heels to return to the standing position.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Hinge at your hips, pushing them backward while keeping a slight bend in your knees.
Lower the dumbbells along the front of your legs until you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to return to the standing position.

name: Step Up
instructions: Stand in front of a bench or sturdy step with your feet hip-width apart.
Place your right foot firmly on the bench and press through your heel to lift your body up.
Step your left foot up to meet your right, standing fully on the bench.
Step back down with your left foot first, followed by your right, and repeat leading with the other leg.

name: Lateral Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet together and your hands at your sides or at your chest.
Take a wide step to the right, bending your right knee and pushing your hips back.
Keep your left leg straight and your right foot flat on the floor as you sink into the lunge.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position and repeat on the left side.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Stand about two feet in front of a bench and place your rear foot on the bench behind you.
Hold dumbbells at your sides or place your hands on your hips for balance.
Lower your body by bending your front knee until your front thigh is parallel to the floor.
Drive through your front heel to stand back up to the starting position.

name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back resting against a bench and your knees bent, feet flat on the floor.
Press through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling until your body forms a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top and hold for a moment.
Lower your hips back to the floor in a controlled manner.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit in a leg press machine with your back flat against the pad and feet shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Release the safety locks and lower the platform toward your chest by bending your knees.
Lower until your knees are bent at 90 degrees without your lower back lifting off the pad.
Press through your heels to push the platform back to the starting position.

name: Sumo Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointed outward at a 45-degree angle.
Hold a dumbbell vertically in front of you with both hands, or place your hands at your hips.
Lower your hips straight down, bending your knees and keeping them tracking over your toes.
Push through your heels to stand back up, squeezing your inner thighs and glutes at the top.

name: Single Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand on your right leg holding a dumbbell in your left hand, with a slight bend in your right knee.
Hinge at your hips to lower the dumbbell toward the floor while extending your left leg straight behind you.
Keep your hips square to the floor and your back flat throughout the movement.
Drive through your right heel to return to the starting position and complete all reps before switching legs.

name: Donkey Kick
instructions: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Keeping your right knee bent at 90 degrees, lift your right leg up toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glute at the top of the movement without arching your lower back.
Lower your leg back to the starting position and complete all reps before switching sides.

name: Fire Hydrant
instructions: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Keeping your right knee bent, lift your right leg out to the side as high as you can.
Keep your hips level and avoid rotating your torso as you lift your leg.
Lower your leg back to the starting position and complete all reps before switching sides.

name: Burpee
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms at your sides.
Drop into a squat position and place your hands on the floor in front of you.
Kick your feet back into a push-up position, perform a push-up, then jump your feet back toward your hands.
Explosively jump straight up with your arms overhead and land softly to begin the next repetition.

name: Jumping Jack
instructions: Stand with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
Jump your feet out to slightly wider than shoulder-width while raising your arms overhead.
Jump your feet back together while lowering your arms back to your sides.
Repeat the movement continuously at a steady pace.

name: Bear Crawl
instructions: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips, knees hovering just above the floor.
Move your right hand and left foot forward simultaneously.
Then move your left hand and right foot forward in a crawling motion.
Continue crawling forward, keeping your hips low and your core engaged the entire time.

name: Inchworm
instructions: Stand with your feet together and hinge at the hips to place your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands forward along the floor until you are in a high plank position.
Pause briefly in the plank, then walk your hands back toward your feet.
Stand up to the starting position and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Lower into a full squat, keeping your chest up and elbows pointing forward.
Drive up explosively from the squat and use the momentum to press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height as you descend into the next squat.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell with both hands.
Hinge at your hips to swing the kettlebell back between your legs.
Drive your hips forward explosively to swing the kettlebell up to chest height.
Control the kettlebell as it swings back down and immediately hinge into the next rep.

name: Turkish Get-Up
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell or dumbbell in your right hand with your arm extended above your chest.
Bend your right knee and place your left hand out to the side, then press up onto your left forearm.
Continue pressing up to your left hand, then lift your hips and sweep your left leg through to a kneeling position.
Stand up fully, then reverse the entire sequence step-by-step to return to the lying position.

name: Clean and Press
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell with an overhand grip at knee height.
Explosively pull the barbell up along your body and catch it at shoulder height in a front rack position.
With the bar at your shoulders, press the barbell overhead to full arm extension.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders, then to the starting position at knee height.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart with the barbell over your mid-foot, shins touching the bar.
Hinge at your hips, grip the bar just outside your knees, and flatten your back.
Drive through your heels and extend your hips and knees to lift the bar to standing.
Lower the bar back to the floor by hinging at your hips first, then bending your knees.

name: Squat to Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Lower into a squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Drive up from the squat and press the dumbbells overhead in one fluid motion.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height as you prepare for the next rep.

name: Renegade Row
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands gripping dumbbells on the floor, slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Keeping your hips level and core tight, row the right dumbbell up toward your hip.
Lower the dumbbell back to the floor and repeat on the left side.
Alternate sides while maintaining a rigid plank position throughout.

name: Man Maker
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, then hinge forward and place them on the floor to enter a plank.
Perform a push-up on the dumbbells, then row the right dumbbell to your hip, followed by the left.
Jump your feet toward your hands and clean the dumbbells to your shoulders.
Press the dumbbells overhead to complete one repetition, then return to the starting position.

name: Sprawl
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands at your sides.
Drop down and place your hands on the floor, kicking your feet back into a plank position.
Lower your hips to the floor briefly, keeping your arms extended.
Jump your feet back toward your hands and stand up to the starting position.

name: Lateral Shuffle
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent in an athletic stance.
Push off your right foot and step laterally to the left with your left foot.
Quickly bring your right foot toward your left, then push off again to continue shuffling.
Shuffle a set distance or time in one direction, then reverse direction.

name: High Knees
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms bent at your sides.
Drive your right knee up toward your chest as high as possible.
Quickly switch legs, driving your left knee up while lowering your right.
Continue alternating legs at a rapid pace, pumping your arms in sync with your legs.

name: Jump Rope
instructions: Hold the jump rope handles at your sides with the rope behind your heels.
Swing the rope overhead and jump over it as it approaches your feet, landing softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your jumps low, just high enough to clear the rope.
Rotate your wrists to swing the rope and maintain a steady rhythm.
